text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days before her Debut, Transcend 
clocked an astonishing time. Just as she 
and her Trainer had planned, the onlookers 
were visibly stunned.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Transcend gathers intel, while the Trainer 
analyzes and evaluates it. Through this 
cycle, her abilities were sharpened 
efficiently.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On race day, Transcend shows her 
composure, saying, "All I have to do is 
run according to plan."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just how will the results turn out—and so, 
Transcend's debut race gets underway!
